subject: website
name: The OG Is Back (Linagee .og registrar)
summary: A React page to search and register .og names on the original Linagee contract on Ethereum. All code is its own, shipped with a source map that carries the sources, and it loads no external code. Level 3, not 4: it checks name availability through the public RPC ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, with no light client, so a lying server could show false data.

operations.name: Search a .og name and check if it is taken
operations.note: Calls owner() on the Linagee contract through ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com; nothing checks the answer.

operations.name: Connect a wallet and register a name
operations.note: Sends reserve() to the Linagee contract at 0x5564886ca2C518d1964E5FCea4f423b41Db9F561 through the user's own wallet; the user confirms the transaction.

operations.name: Show the page and its fonts
operations.note: All scripts, styles and fonts are the build's own files, with source in the source map.

connections.name: ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (Ethereum RPC)
connections.note: Public RPC server read without a light client; it sees the visitor's IP address and the names searched.
